# The prompt corpus

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/render_prompt_corpus.py — DO NOT EDIT. Edit the source named below, then re-run the script. -->

Every prompt this framework puts in front of a model, in one place (issue #280). A clean-room reimplementer needs the text, not a paraphrase of it: the orchestration graph and the JSON Schemas say what the output must look like, and only the prompt says how to get a model to produce it.

`scripts/render_prompt_corpus.py` writes this directory from the sources below and `--check` fails when any of them has moved on. Nothing here is hand-written, and editing a generated file changes nothing — re-run the script instead.

These are already standalone, verbatim, tracked files. ## Deliberately not in the corpus

| File | Why |

| `templates/README.md.j2` | vault documentation |

| `templates/index-files/_graph.md.j2` | an index file, not a prompt |
| `templates/index-files/_index.md.j2` | an index file, not a prompt |
| `templates/update_vault.py.j2` | a script |
| `templates/vault-config.yaml.j2` | configuration |
| `templates/vault-research.service.j2` | a systemd unit |
| `templates/vault-script.sh.j2` | the `./vault` shim (spec 077) |

`.claude/skills/` is excluded as a whole: those are spec-kit authoring skills for contributors to this repo, not prompts the framework dispatches at a vault.

## What reads this directory

`tests/docs/test_prompt_corpus_is_current.py` runs the renderer in `--check` mode, so a prompt edited without re-running the script fails the guard battery; and it fails on any prompt-shaped file the renderer has not been told how to classify, so the corpus cannot quietly stop being complete.
